answer: A river of diverse attestations stops sybils when only non-kin peers make an answer count. First, each answer needs 5 attestations from 5 separate clusters with no shared funding. Second, the network checks cluster distance on-chain, so clones attesting each other add nothing. Third, a beacon score shows how independent attestors are before grading. Fourth, clustered fakes are marked hollow and lose weight. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 50,000 attestations from real clusters, while one honest answer needs only 5. Like a river that cannot be faked by one spring, trust flows from many sources.
